SMARTPORT NET TRANSPORT CHECKPOINT      
R: SLOT ROM   L: LIBTINI-STYLE FIFO     
X: RESET LOOP P: RECOVERY PROBE         
SPEED LABEL: 1=1 MHZ, T=TURBO           
GEN=4; 10000 READS; 9..512 BYTES        
NETSP AND NETD2 SCRATCH FILES REQUIRED  
SCRATCH DISK CHECK FAILED               
FAIL AT READ 0 RC=00                    
PRESS A KEY TO RETURN
